title: Best schools to work for in Ho Chi Minh City (2026)
description: No Saigon school has a Teachers' Choice 2026 rating yet. What teachers review (pay, hours, contract, work permit, management) and how to vote before 31 December.
h1: Best schools to work for in Ho Chi Minh City: how teachers rate employers, and how to review yours
intro: No Ho Chi Minh City school has earned a teacher-voted rating yet: as of 24 November 2026, none of the 172 employers in the eno.vn school directory has qualified for Teachers' Choice 2026, and voting closes on 31 December 2026. Teachers' Choice is eno.vn's yearly record of the places teachers recommend, and results are recorded when the year closes, in January 2027. Until then, judge a school on pay on time, hours, the contract, work permit support and management.
keyPoints: As of 24 November 2026, **no school has qualified** for Teachers' Choice 2026. Every school in the eno.vn directory shows 'No votes yet'.
To qualify, a place needs **votes from at least 10 teachers**, more up than down, and **at least 3 reviews** that a moderator has read, all cast during 2026.
Only votes and reviews cast during 2026, Saigon time, count, so voting closes at **midnight on 31 December 2026**. Results are recorded when the year closes and never change afterwards.
You need to be signed in to vote or review. Business accounts cannot vote, and a school's own account cannot vote on or review that school.

A review describes your own experience and can include your pay. The most useful reviews cover **pay and how it was paid**, hours and class sizes, the contract and the work permit, and management and training. A moderator reads every review before it appears.

sections.title: What are the best schools to work for in Ho Chi Minh City?

blocks.text: No teacher-voted answer exists yet. As of 24 November 2026, no school in the [eno.vn school directory](/schools) had qualified for Teachers' Choice 2026, and every one of its listings showed 'No votes yet'. An empty page tells you nothing, good or bad, about an employer.

For now, the best school to work for is one you have checked yourself on the things teachers report: **pay, hours, the contract, work permit support and management**. The next sections turn those into questions to ask before you sign. To check that an employer is real in the first place, see [teaching job scams in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/teaching-job-scams-in-vietnam).

blocks.title: What the directory is
blocks.text: **Saigon schools, ranked by teachers** is eno.vn's list of Ho Chi Minh City employers. Teachers who worked or interviewed at a school can vote on it, and those who worked there can review it. eno.vn runs the directory. It has not verified the schools on it and does not recommend any of them.

sections.title: Which schools in Ho Chi Minh City are on the list?

blocks.text: The directory lists 172 Ho Chi Minh City employers of five types. Those counts come from eno.vn's /schools page as of 24 November 2026. Teachers' Choice has one category for each type of place, so a language centre only competes with other language centres.

Evening and weekend classes, often paid by the hour: [working at a language centre](/teach-in-vietnam/language-centre-jobs-in-ho-chi-minh-city)

blocks.text: Can I find schools near me?

Yes. Each school's entry lists the areas where it has branches, using the old district names that teachers and job ads still use, such as District 1, District 7, Binh Thanh, Go Vap or Thu Duc City (District 2 and District 9), and the directory can be filtered by area. Since 1 July 2025, official addresses have used new ward names, so the address on a contract may not look familiar. To choose a neighbourhood near work, see [where to live in Ho Chi Minh City as a teacher](/teach-in-vietnam/where-to-live-in-ho-chi-minh-city-as-a-teacher).

School pages also show live Ho Chi Minh City job listings whose employer name matches the school. The full board is at [teaching jobs](/jobs-vietnam-expats). eno.vn has not verified these employers. If a school you worked at is missing, you can suggest it from the directory, and a moderator adds it.

sections.title: What makes a school good to work for?

blocks.text: A good employer pays in full on the agreed date, gives you the hours it promised, puts the deal in a written contract, files your work permit properly, and has managers who train and support you. These are also the things a review is most useful for, because each review on eno.vn describes the writer's own experience of the school.

blocks.caption: Four things to check in a school, and what to ask an employer about each before you sign
rows: Pay and how it was paid
On time and in full, per hour or per month as agreed
Which day is pay day? Is pay ever split or late? Are cancelled classes paid?
Hours, class sizes and last-minute changes
Hours close to the offer, and warning before the timetable changes
How many hours a week are guaranteed? How large are the classes? How much notice do you give of changes?
The contract and the work permit
What was promised is what happened
Who files and pays for the work permit, and when? Is everything in the written contract? See [contracts](/teach-in-vietnam/english-teaching-contracts-in-vietnam)
Management, training and support
An induction, feedback on observed lessons, a manager who answers
Who is my line manager? What training is there in the first month?

blocks.text: Does the law require schools to pay on time?

Yes. Article 94 of the [Labour Code 2019](https://hethongphapluat.com/bo-luat-lao-dong-2019/dieu-94) says an employer must pay wages **directly, in full and on time**. Under [Article 97](https://hethongphapluat.com/bo-luat-lao-dong-2019/dieu-97), staff paid by the hour, day or week can be paid in a lump sum if both sides agree, but at least once every 15 days. Staff paid monthly are paid once or twice a month, on a fixed recurring date that both sides agree.

An employer that cannot pay because of force majeure may delay payment by no more than 30 days. If the delay is 15 days or more, it must also pay at least interest on the late amount. A school that is regularly late without that excuse is breaking the rule, and that is exactly what a review should record.
What counts as good work permit support?

Good support means the school files your work permit on time, tells you which documents it needs, and says in writing who pays. Under Decree 219/2025/ND-CP, in force since 7 August 2025, the employer files the application, not the teacher, and a permit lasts no more than two years ([the decree text](https://luatvietnam.vn/lao-dong/nghi-dinh-219-2025-nd-cp-quy-dinh-ve-nguoi-lao-dong-nuoc-ngoai-tai-viet-nam-407607-d1.html)). According to LuatVietnam, Decree 393/2026/ND-CP was issued on 20 October 2026 and replaces Decree 219 from 5 December 2026 ([LuatVietnam](https://luatvietnam.vn/legal-updates/decree-no-393-2026-nd-cp-on-foreign-workers-working-in-vietnam-issued-892-114284-article.html)). Your employer and the authority have the final word on what is filed. See [the work permit guide](/teach-in-vietnam/vietnam-work-permit-for-english-teachers).

Teachers' Choice 2026 is eno.vn's yearly record of the places teachers recommend, with one category for each type of place. Only votes and reviews cast during 2026, Saigon time, count, so voting closes at midnight on 31 December 2026. According to eno.vn's /schools page, as of 24 November 2026, the results are recorded when the year closes, so they come in January 2027.

blocks.caption: Teachers' Choice 2026 rules, from eno.vn's /schools page as read on 24 November 2026
rows: Who can vote

Anyone signed in to eno.vn, voting on places they worked or interviewed at. One vote per account per school, and who voted is never shown. Business accounts cannot vote, and a school's own account cannot vote on itself
Your vote
Up or down
The bar to qualify
Votes from at least 10 teachers, more of them up than down, and at least 3 reviews a moderator has read, all during 2026 in Saigon time
Categories
One per type of place: language centres, international schools, bilingual schools, teacher agencies and universities. Each place competes only within its own category
How places are ranked
By the same score as the directory's 'Top rated' order: the lower bound of a 95% confidence interval on the share of up-votes
What shows during the year
Only the names of places that qualify
Results
Recorded when the year closes, and never changed afterwards

blocks.title: No winners exist yet
blocks.text: As of 24 November 2026, every school in the directory showed 'No votes yet', so none has the 10 votes it needs and none has qualified. Results are not recorded until the year closes, so no school can be a Teachers' Choice 2026 winner before January 2027.
Why does a school not show a recommend percentage?

According to /schools, a '% recommend' figure appears only once a school has 5 votes. The 'Top rated' order uses the same cautious score as Teachers' Choice, the lower bound of a confidence interval. That stops a handful of votes from putting a school above one that many teachers have rated.

sections.title: How do I vote on and review a school I worked at?

blocks.text: Sign in to eno.vn, open the school's page from [the directory](/schools), vote it up or down and write your review. A moderator reads every review before it appears, so it will not show up immediately.

items.title: Sign in with a personal account
items.text: You must be signed in to vote or review. Business accounts cannot vote, and a school cannot vote on or review itself.

items.title: Find the school
items.text: Browse [the directory](/schools) by type (language centres, international schools, bilingual schools, teacher agencies or universities) or by area. If the school is missing, suggest it.

items.title: Vote up or down
items.text: Vote on a place where you worked or interviewed. You get one vote per account per school, and who voted is never shown.

items.title: Write one review
items.text: Review only a place where you worked, and only once per school. A review describes your own experience. The most useful ones cover pay and how it was paid, hours and class sizes, the contract and the work permit, and management and training.

items.title: Add your pay if you want
items.text: Reported pay is never shown next to a review or a name. A school's pay range appears only once at least 5 teachers have reported pay for the same period (per hour or per month) within the last 3 years. The range shows the middle 60% of reports and updates weekly.

items.title: Wait for the moderator
items.text: Your review appears once a moderator has read it. Only reviews a moderator has read count towards the 3 a school needs to qualify for Teachers' Choice.

blocks.text: What can I not put in a review?

items: Names of individual people, such as a manager or a colleague.

blocks.text: Your name is hidden. Each review shows only a broad description of the person who wrote it, such as 'Former teacher · 1–2 years'.
Can a school remove my review?
No. A report never removes a review automatically, and a moderator decides what happens. A school can reply to a review or ask for a correction.

blocks.title: Write what happened, with dates
blocks.text: A review that says when pay arrived compared with the contract date, how many hours you got against the number offered, and whether the work permit was filed as promised is more useful to the next teacher than general praise or complaint.

sections.title: Where are teacher reviews of ILA, VUS and Apollo?

blocks.text: ILA Vietnam, VUS The English Center and Apollo English are all listed with the other language centres in [the directory](/schools). Teachers who worked at any of them can vote on and review them there. As of 24 November 2026, all three, like every other school in the directory, showed 'No votes yet'.

For what working at the big chains involves, including hours, observations and how contracts are usually set up, see [working at a language centre in Ho Chi Minh City](/teach-in-vietnam/language-centre-jobs-in-ho-chi-minh-city). This guide does not repeat that comparison.

faqs.q: What are the best schools to work for in Vietnam?
faqs.a: There is no teacher-voted list yet of the best schools to work for in Ho Chi Minh City. As of 24 November 2026, none of the 172 employers in the eno.vn school directory had qualified for Teachers' Choice 2026, and every school showed no votes. Until results come in January 2027, judge a school on whether it pays on time, gives the hours it promised, offers a written contract, files the work permit and supports its teachers.

faqs.q: Are there teacher reviews of ILA Vietnam?
faqs.a: ILA Vietnam is listed with the other language centres in eno.vn's Ho Chi Minh City school directory. Teachers who worked there can review it, and a moderator reads each review before it appears. As of 24 November 2026, ILA Vietnam, like every school in the directory, showed no votes, so check the ILA Vietnam page itself before relying on it. eno.vn's guide to working at a language centre in Ho Chi Minh City covers what working at the big chains involves.

faqs.q: Who can vote in Teachers' Choice 2026?
faqs.a: Anyone signed in to eno.vn can vote in Teachers' Choice 2026 on Ho Chi Minh City schools where they worked or interviewed, with one up or down vote per account per school. Business accounts cannot vote, and a school's own account cannot vote on or review that school. Who voted is never shown on the school's page in the eno.vn directory.

faqs.q: When are the Teachers' Choice 2026 results announced?
faqs.a: Teachers' Choice 2026 counts only votes and reviews cast during 2026, Saigon time, so voting closes at midnight on 31 December 2026. According to eno.vn's school directory, results are recorded when the year closes and never change afterwards, so they come in January 2027. As of 24 November 2026, every school in the directory showed no votes, so no school had qualified in any of the five categories.

faqs.q: How many votes does a school need to qualify for Teachers' Choice 2026?
faqs.a: A school qualifies for Teachers' Choice 2026 with votes from at least 10 teachers, more of them up than down, and at least 3 reviews that a moderator has read, all cast during 2026 in Saigon time. Qualifying schools are ranked within their category by the lower bound of a 95% confidence interval on their share of up-votes, the same score eno.vn uses for its Top rated order.

faqs.q: How do I write a review of a school in Ho Chi Minh City on eno.vn?
faqs.a: To review a Ho Chi Minh City school on eno.vn, sign in, open the school's page in the directory at eno.vn/schools and write your review. You can review a school only if you worked there, and only once per school. Cover pay, hours, the contract, the work permit and management. Do not name individuals, share personal details or include links. A moderator reads the review before it appears.

faqs.q: Can a school delete a bad review on eno.vn?
faqs.a: A school cannot delete a review on eno.vn. Reports never remove a review automatically, and a moderator decides what happens to it. A school can reply publicly or ask for a correction. Reviewers' names are hidden, and each review shows only a broad description of the writer. Pay that a teacher reports is never shown next to the review or a name.

faqs.q: Do schools in Vietnam have to pay teachers on time?
faqs.a: Yes. Vietnam's Labour Code 2019 requires every employer, including schools and language centres, to pay wages directly, in full and on time (Article 94). Teachers paid by the hour can be paid in a lump sum, but at least once every 15 days. Monthly-paid teachers are paid once or twice a month on a fixed date (Article 97). A delay caused by force majeure may not exceed 30 days, and a delay of 15 days or more carries interest.
